comment: Renderer-neutral look values neither the lighting bible (lighting-bible.json) nor the rain pack (rain-bible.json) fixes, tuned for the owner's phone checks. Both renderers read them from here; nothing look-related is hard-coded in shaders or Swift (owner, 6 Oct). Change log: docs/look-spec-changes.md.

daytimeMaster.comment: Engine calibration only (owner, 7 Oct: look values come from mock-values.json, house-contrast-v1 sharedLighting). key and fill scale the clear-day sun and sky fill under the master so a neutral patch's shadow/lit linear luminance meets the master's 0.62 (shadows.strengthPercent 38). Measured on the simulator; see docs/look-spec-changes.md.

shoreProfiles.comment: Generator (P2): style profile → lake-winter-v1 water profile (water.profiles.<id>; index = position in 'order', sent in water-mesh extra.w). Shore band width = that profile's shallowBlendWidthM from mock-values.json; extra.z = metres from the shore (open water 1000).

wetPaving.comment: Departure from rain-v1 (owner's phone check, 7 Oct): the pack's paving darkening x3.8, so steady rain darkens concrete ~38% and asphalt ~42%, light rain ~30%.

houseContrast.comment: Generator (P2), house-details families: house-contrast-v1 (R approved, binding) per house type, read by key from Profiles/mock-values.json (generated by Tools/lookloop/compile_mocks.py; one source): trim, roof and daytime glass colours; soffit and porch-underside colours on down-facing faces; the eave/cornice shadow band fading to eave_shadow.relativeBrightness (wall = 1) at the eave line or parapet top. Walls stay observed/profile colours. families: P2 mapping of house families to the pack's four types by type and wall material (docs/buildings/README.md); 'flat' = two- or three-flat by storeys. eaveBandHeight is the existing near wall band (geometry), not a pack value. brickWallFamilies: Chicago brick families whose walls take one of the pack's three brick wall swatches (three-flat, two-flat, bungalow), seeded per building (variation between buildings, owner 7 Oct), unless building:colour is mapped; their windows get the stone lintel/sill openings in the type's trim, a reveal strip in the soffit colour, and a foundation course in the trim colour (stone base). Denver (front-range) families map too: bungalow/foursquare/ranch → bungalow, cottage → workers cottage, duplex → two-flat (brick walls; the denver paint-over's near house). Mapped families get the contrast values with or without a house-details recipe. House archetypes (P2 2026-10-07, merged with house-archetypes-v1): archetype house types keep their archetype palette (wall, trim, roof, glass) over these swatches; mapped archetype families still take soffit, porch underside, eave band and stone openings. foursquare and ranch (Chicago and Denver archetypes share these ids) and duplex (denver-06-infill, charcoal trim) are not mapped: the chicago_bungalow / two-flat trim and roof fall outside those archetypes' variants (dE 4.7-56).

shadows.comment: Owner, 7 Oct: tree-crown shadows must reach the lawns; real shadows out to 120 m, 150 m at low sun (was 60 / 80 m), blob shadows only beyond. 150 m all day measured worse near the camera (one shadow map over 2.5x the ground: the nearest crown shadow softened and shrank, dark share 0.33 -> 0.25) for little gain past 60 m.

archetypes.comment: Generator (P2), house-archetypes-v1 (R approved 2026-10-07, binding): the archetype values themselves are read by key from Profiles/mock-values.json; this block holds only P2 mapping values the pack does not give (judgments, not pack values). aspectFactor/areaRange: soft footprint preference around each sheet's footprint (frontage/depth divided and multiplied by aspectFactor; area times areaRange) for families without their own grammar aspect/area. roofTagFloor: weight multiplier for a type whose roof mix has no share of a mapped roof:shape (tags as evidence). splitMainShare: frontage share of the split-level's two-storey block, judged from the denver-05-split artwork; splitMinRectangularity: only near-rectangular footprints are split. farPorchShade: far-tier (6-20 px) porch/entry void as a wall shade where no house-contrast-v1 porch_shadow exists. tierFrameHeightPx/tierFovDegrees: reference phone frame for mapping the sheets' px tiers onto distances (the 1005x565 phone side-by-side frame, the engine's default 50 deg vertical FOV); docs/buildings/README.md 'Archetypes'.

nightWindows.comment: Generator (P2), night-fog-v1 (binding): style profile → night-fog-v1 areaProfiles[].id whose windowWarmShare sets each window's warm (1) or cool (0) flag in glass vertex extra.z (seeded per window); 5A's shader reads it with windows.warmHex/coolHex. Unmapped profiles use the first listed area.
